_comment: Aseprite MCP server, used to convert and organise the itch.io pixel packs
in assets/ and wire them into the map and card systems.
This file previously ran `uv run -m aseprite_mcp` with no cwd, which fails:
there is no aseprite_mcp module on the default interpreter. The working
install lives at C:/Users/thecr/aseprite-mcp with its own virtualenv, and
that is what the user-level registration in ~/.claude.json already points
at. This file now matches it so the repo is not carrying a second, broken
Claude Code reads USER-level servers from ~/.claude.json and PROJECT-level
servers from .mcp.json (leading dot) — not from this file. Keep this as the
documented reference; run `claude mcp list` to see what is actually loaded.
